entities.title: Trading at a market panel
entities.summary: Any item, any order, a stepper and partial sales, instead of RULES' buy and sell prompts.
entities.context: UI-DESIGN's market panel differs from RULES' prompts.
entities.decision: buy and sell take a quantity the stepper sets; prices are fixed per visit, with no spread and no random draws (deliberate difference 12).
entities.rationale: Checked to reach exactly the purchases and refusals the prompts reach.
